1E:76DA.name: StoreTemp0BytesToSRAMRecord
1E:76DA.note: A = record, C = field offset (SRAMRecordAddress), B = count: copies B bytes from hFFC6 onward into the SRAM record (SRAM must be enabled); DE and HL kept (E-0074)

16:6961.name: ShowStringCategory5Immediate_Bank16
16:6961.note: wStringCategory = 5 (wStringIndex set by the caller), then far-calls ShowString_Bank2F (E-0074)

15:67E5.name: BlankWordTableTargets
15:67E5.note: HL = table of addresses, C = count: stores tile $C3 at the address in each of the first C entries (StoreBAtWordTableEntry_Bank15) (E-0074)

12:6990.name: CountKeysOrFull
12:6990.note: counts the 4-byte wKeyList entries before the first $FF: hFFC6 = the count, or $80 when all 32 are in use (E-0074)

1C:4C9A.name: DrawItemGridXCursor
1C:4C9A.note: writes the cursor tile $BB at the position for wD7B5 (0-3; BG map offsets $00A2, $00E2, $0122, $0162 from the scroll origin, Data_01C_4CC4), via StepBGMapAddressBackOnScrollWrap and WaitForVRAMAccess (E-0074)

1C:4C9E.name: EraseItemGridXCursor
1C:4C9E.note: writes the blank tile $C3 at the position for wD7B5 (0-3; BG map offsets $00A2, $00E2, $0122, $0162 from the scroll origin, Data_01C_4CC4), via StepBGMapAddressBackOnScrollWrap and WaitForVRAMAccess (E-0074)

1C:4CA2.name: DrawItemGridXCursorConfirmed
1C:4CA2.note: writes the confirmed-cursor tile $BC at the position for wD7B5 (0-3; BG map offsets $00A2, $00E2, $0122, $0162 from the scroll origin, Data_01C_4CC4), via StepBGMapAddressBackOnScrollWrap and WaitForVRAMAccess (E-0074)

12:7EC2.name: AddGoldCapped
12:7EC2.note: adds the word hFFC6/hFFC7 to the 24-bit wGoldLo/Mid/Hi and caps the result at $01869F (99,999) (E-0074)

07:695A.name: InitGoldAndClearInventory
07:695A.note: wGold = 100 and the 24 wInventory slots = 0 (the new-game setup path, Func_007_65F1) (E-0074)

24:68B0.name: DrawGoldPanel_Bank24
24:68B0.note: copies an 8 x 3 frame (Data_024_68EB) into the screen buffer at wC370, converts wGold to packed BCD (Number24ToPackedBCD) and Func_015_6676, then writes the digits as tiles $E0 + d at wC386 (E-0074)

15:68FA.name: TestBitInFieldAtArg3
15:68FA.note: index = the word wD7F1/wD7F2, field = the address in wD7F3/wD7F4: wD7F5 = $FF when bit index of the field is set (bit order $80 first within each byte), else 0 (E-0074)

12:7E84.name: SubtractGoldFloorZero
12:7E84.note: wGold -= the word hFFC6/hFFC7; when gold is smaller than the amount it becomes 0 instead (E-0075)

12:7F1C.name: DeductGoldPenalty
12:7F1C.note: takes gold: all of it when below 150, 150 when below 1,500 ($05DC), otherwise one tenth (Divide24ByA, rounded down) (E-0075)

05:6972.name: ActorStatus4CheckReadsAddress
05:6972.note: apparently meant to test the actor's status byte 4 (wD810 + 9 * actor) & $03 like the neighbouring checks, but it never loads the byte: it tests A & 3 where A is the low byte of that address left by AddAx9ToHL. So C = $FF for slots 0 and 4 and C = 0 for slots 1, 2, 5 and 6 whatever the status (a likely bug; executed, test Status4CheckReadsAddress) (E-0075)

12:7662.name: EventCheckGoldAtLeast10000
12:7662.note: when story flag $192 is set, flag $193 is clear and gold >= 10,000 ($2710): wC935 = $CC and carry set; otherwise A = 0 and carry clear (E-0075)

31:7536.name: DrawWC278RowsToBGMapRow7
31:7536.note: copies a 20 x 11 rectangle from wC278 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $E0 (row 7), falling into CopyRect32StrideToVRAM (E-0075)

1E:76F3.name: GetListEntriesCell4Address
1E:76F3.note: far-calls SetArg5ToListEntriesCell4, then HL = wD7F5 (high) / wD7F6 (low) (E-0075)

1E:76EB.name: GetListEntriesCell5Address
1E:76EB.note: far-calls SetArg5ToListEntriesCell5, then HL = wD7F5 (high) / wD7F6 (low) (E-0075)

02:4176.name: FadeColorComponentFloor
02:4176.note: the 5-bit component in C's low bits becomes max(component, wC572) when wC56D bit 7 is clear (lighten toward the level) or max(component - wC572, 0) when it is set (darken); then B:C:D:E is rotated right 5 bits so the next component comes down and the result collects in D:E (E-0076)

02:426D.name: FadeColorComponentAdd
02:426D.note: the 5-bit component in C's low bits becomes min(component + wC572, $1F) when wC56D bit 7 is clear (lighten) or max(component - wC572, 0) when it is set (darken); then B:C:D:E is rotated right 5 bits so the next component comes down and the result collects in D:E (E-0076)

02:4152.name: WriteFadedColorFloorToBGPD
02:4152.note: reads one RGB555 colour word at HL (HL += 2), passes its three components through FadeColorComponentFloor and writes the result to rBGPD (low byte first, after WaitForVRAMAccess) (E-0076)

02:4121.name: WriteFadedColorFloorToOBPD
02:4121.note: reads one RGB555 colour word at HL (HL += 2), passes its three components through FadeColorComponentFloor and writes the result to rOBPD (low byte first, after WaitForVRAMAccess); its load of wC572 into D is overwritten at once (E-0076)

02:4249.name: WriteFadedColorAddToBGPD
02:4249.note: reads one RGB555 colour word at HL (HL += 2), passes its three components through FadeColorComponentAdd and writes the result to rBGPD (low byte first, after WaitForVRAMAccess) (E-0076)

02:4218.name: WriteFadedColorAddToOBPD
02:4218.note: reads one RGB555 colour word at HL (HL += 2), passes its three components through FadeColorComponentAdd and writes the result to rOBPD (low byte first, after WaitForVRAMAccess); its load of wC572 into D is overwritten at once (E-0076)

02:4149.name: WriteFadedPaletteFloorToBGPD
02:4149.note: four colours (one palette) from HL through WriteFadedColorFloorToBGPD (E-0076)

02:4118.name: WriteFadedPaletteFloorToOBPD
02:4118.note: four colours (one palette) from HL through WriteFadedColorFloorToOBPD (E-0076)

02:4240.name: WriteFadedPaletteAddToBGPD
02:4240.note: four colours (one palette) from HL through WriteFadedColorAddToBGPD (E-0076)

02:420F.name: WriteFadedPaletteAddToOBPD
02:420F.note: four colours (one palette) from HL through WriteFadedColorAddToOBPD (E-0076)

02:40CF.name: WriteAllFadedPalettesFloor
02:40CF.note: rBGPI = $80 (palette 0, auto-increment), the 8 BG palettes from wC49F through WriteFadedPaletteFloorToBGPD; then rOBPI = $80 and the 8 OBJ palettes from wC4DF through WriteFadedPaletteFloorToOBPD (E-0076)

02:41C6.name: WriteAllFadedPalettesAdd
02:41C6.note: rBGPI = $80, the 8 BG palettes from wC49F through WriteFadedPaletteAddToBGPD; then rOBPI = $80 and the 8 OBJ palettes from wC4DF through WriteFadedPaletteAddToOBPD (E-0076)

03:4DCF.name: ShowSkillNameAtSlotB
03:4DCF.note: A = skill number ($FF shows entry 0), B = slot: wStringIndex = A, wStringCategory = 4 (StringTable_SkillNames in the bank-$08 database), then ShowStringBank08AtTilesHL with the tile address from Data_003_4DF2[B] and size $0901; HL kept (E-0076)

F2:516E.name: CopyTileBytesToVRAMCounted_BankF2
F2:516E.note: copies 16 bytes from HL to DE, each written with interrupts off after rSTAT bit 1 clears (the same effect as CopyTileBytesToVRAM, with a counter kept on the stack); HL and DE advance (E-0076)

A0:4C74.name: DrawWC338RowsToBGMapRow13_BankA0
A0:4C74.note: copies a 20 x 5 rectangle from wC338 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $1A0 (row 13) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM_BankA0, as DrawWC338RowsToBGMapRow13 does in bank $31 (E-0076)

02:4071.name: StepCGBFade
02:4071.note: one CGB fade step: counts wFadeDelayCounter down and, when it reaches 0, reloads it from wFadeDelay and moves wFadeLevel by 5. With wFadeState bit 7 clear (fading out) the level rises to at most $1F and WriteAllFadedPalettesFloor writes the palettes; with bit 7 set (fading in) it falls to at least 0 and WriteAllFadedPalettesAdd writes them. wFadeState = 0 when the level reaches $1F or 0 (E-0077)

00:3A4E.name: WriteChannelRegisterC
00:3A4E.note: A = value, C = register offset: writes A to $FF00 + wDD0D + C (wDD0D holds the current sound channel's register base); B = A (E-0077)

00:210D.name: WriteTwoDigitTilesFromWC8C1
00:210D.note: DE = destination: writes wC8C1 as tile $E0 + digit, or blank tile $C3 when it is 0, then wC8C2 as $E0 + digit; DE ends past the second tile; HL kept (E-0077)

05:44CF.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus0MaskCC
05:44CF.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 0 (wBattleStatus) & $CC clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask), else 0 (E-0077)

E0:740E.name: FillVRAMRectWithTileSequence
E0:740E.note: A = first tile, B = width, C = rows, HL = VRAM address, DE = row stride: writes consecutive tile numbers with WriteVRAMByteInc (interrupts off per byte), adding DE to the row start after each row; A ends past the last tile (E-0077)

84:43AC.name: RandomBelowC

3B:42F0.name: LoadBCFromHL

36:608B.name: StoreBCAtActorWordEntry
36:608B.note: HL = table: stores BC (low byte first) at HL + 2 * wBattleActor; HL ends on the high byte (E-0077)

31:74C8.name: DrawWC2B8RowsToBGMapRow9
31:74C8.note: copies a 20 x 9 rectangle from wC2B8 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $120 (row 9) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM, then wD868 = 1 (E-0077)

3A:79A0.name: CopyBattlerNameToHL

3A:799C.name: CopySlotNameToHL

3A:7927.name: CopyTargetNameToTextBuf0

F1:4AA8.name: ClearScreenBufferAndAttributes_BankF1
F1:4AA8.note: fills the $2D0 bytes $C198-$C467 (wScreenTileBuffer, $240 bytes, and the $90 bytes after it) with $C3; on CGB continues with the attribute buffer (not fully read) (E-0077)

00:3048.name: AdvanceBGMapColumnsByB

00:2FC7.name: DivideBCByDE

05:4664.name: AnyFoeHasClearStatus3

16:468E.name: ApplyItemEffect
16:468E.note: returns when wItemId is $FF; otherwise jumps through a 95-entry table with one effect per item id. The Herb entry adds (wC5E7 after NextTableByte) / 11 + wD08F to record wD083 (Func_016_57D1) and then runs ConsumeSelectedItemByChance; CheckItemUsable is the matching usability check (E-0089)

00:2E5D.name: IncrementTextPosLoWord
00:2E5D.note: HL = the word at wC533/wC534, then that word += 1 (E-0090)

00:18D6.name: ReadFarPointerAtDEInBankB
00:18D6.note: with ROM bank B mapped, reads three bytes at DE: HL = the word, B = the third byte (a far pointer: address then bank); DE += 3; restores the bank (E-0090)

00:305E.name: AddHLToTextCursorTextCursorLo
00:305E.note: HL = wC554/wC555 + HL, with the high byte's low 2 bits wrapped and its upper 6 bits kept from wC555 (stays inside one 1 KB BG map) (E-0090)

00:3EDE.name: NextTableByteSecondStream
00:3EDE.note: advances a second random stream: loads the state in wC5BA/wC5BB into wC5E7/wC5E8, runs NextTableByte and stores the result back in wC5BA/wC5BB (wC5E7/wC5E8 keep the new value); HL kept (E-0090)

00:2458.name: WriteKeyNameToDE
00:2458.note: A = key slot, or $FE: writes 'Magic Key' to DE; otherwise writes the name of key A in wKeyList (4-byte entries from $C708): the word numbered byte 0 + 1, then the word numbered byte 1 + $11 (CopyKeyNameWordToDE), then $F0 (E-0090)

00:24A2.name: CopyKeyNameWordToDE
00:24A2.note: A = word number: with ROM bank $09 mapped, copies that string of the bank-$09 database's category 3 (Data_009_4078: Ylw, Plain, Green, ... then Slime, Draco, Beast, ... Cave, Isle) with its $F0 to DE; restores the bank (E-0090)

00:160B.name: CopyRectFromBankToBGMapWrapped
00:160B.note: A = ROM bank, DE = source in that bank, B = width, C = rows, HL = BG map address: switches to the bank and copies the rectangle with WriteVRAMByteInc (interrupts off per byte), wrapping columns inside each 32-entry row and rows inside $9800-$9BFF (H &= $9B); restores the bank (E-0090)

00:3095.name: BlankBGMapEntriesRight
00:3095.note: writes tile $C3 (WriteVRAMByte) to B BG map entries from HL rightward, wrapping inside the 32-entry row (NextBGMapColumn); B = 0 (E-0090)

00:2DED.name: CopyCBytesToVRAMWaitSTAT
00:2DED.note: copies C bytes from HL to DE, waiting for rSTAT bit 1 to clear before each (interrupts stay on); HL and DE advance, C = 0 (E-0090)

00:0DCA.name: ResetFadeFromDMGPaletteBGP
00:0DCA.note: wC56F-wC571 = wC5E9-wC5EB; then clears wFadeLevel and the four bytes after it and wFadeState, and sets wC56D = 7 and wC56E = $1F (E-0090)

00:3072.name: BGMapAddressAtScrollPlusHL
00:3072.note: HL = offset in a 32 x 32 BG map: returns HL = $9800 + ((HL + (hScrollY & $F8) * 4 + hScrollX / 8) & $3FF), the entry that offset points at from the scroll origin, wrapping inside the map (E-0090)

00:2F5A.name: Divide24ByHFFCCDE
00:2F5A.note: A = the 24-bit hFFC8:hFFC7:hFFC6 divided by the 24-bit hFFCC:D:E (repeated subtraction; the quotient must fit in 8 bits); the remainder is left in hFFC6-hFFC8; HL kept (E-0090)

00:2F36.name: Quotient24ByHFFCCDE
00:2F36.note: Divide24ByHFFCCDE with hFFC6-hFFC8 restored afterwards (A = the quotient); uses wC0A0, wC0A1 and wMenuRowCount as scratch, so wMenuRowCount is overwritten (E-0090)

05:55F3.name: CheckWD044RuleBit5
05:55F3.note: C = 0 (fail) when wC58A is neither 0 nor 2, wD044 bits 7 and 5 are set, and either wD045 bit 5 is clear or bit 5 is set in the actor side's byte wD057[actor / 4]; otherwise C = $FF (E-0091)

E2:6854.name: WeighWD044RuleBit5
E2:6854.note: far-calls CheckWD044RuleBit5; when it fails (C = 0) adds weight-table entry $0E to wDA70 (AccumulateBank6WordToDA70); used by the AI scoring routines (E-0091)

05:5628.name: CheckWD044RuleBit4
05:5628.note: C = 0 (fail) when wC58A is neither 0 nor 2, wD044 bits 7 and 4 are set, and either wD045 bit 4 is clear or bit 4 is set in the actor side's byte wD057[actor / 4]; otherwise C = $FF (E-0091)

E2:6865.name: WeighWD044RuleBit4
E2:6865.note: far-calls CheckWD044RuleBit4; when it fails (C = 0) adds weight-table entry $0E to wDA70 (AccumulateBank6WordToDA70); used by the AI scoring routines (E-0091)

05:565D.name: CheckWD044RuleBit3
05:565D.note: C = 0 (fail) when wC58A is neither 0 nor 2, wD044 bits 7 and 3 are set, and either wD045 bit 3 is clear or bit 3 is set in the actor side's byte wD057[actor / 4]; otherwise C = $FF (E-0091)

E2:6876.name: WeighWD044RuleBit3
E2:6876.note: far-calls CheckWD044RuleBit3; when it fails (C = 0) adds weight-table entry $0E to wDA70 (AccumulateBank6WordToDA70); used by the AI scoring routines (E-0091)

05:5692.name: CheckWD044RuleBit2
05:5692.note: C = 0 (fail) when wC58A is neither 0 nor 2, wD044 bits 7 and 2 are set, and either wD045 bit 2 is clear or bit 2 is set in the actor side's byte wD057[actor / 4]; otherwise C = $FF (E-0091)

E2:6887.name: WeighWD044RuleBit2
E2:6887.note: far-calls CheckWD044RuleBit2; when it fails (C = 0) adds weight-table entry $0E to wDA70 (AccumulateBank6WordToDA70); used by the AI scoring routines (E-0091)

05:56C7.name: CheckWD044RuleBit1
05:56C7.note: C = 0 (fail) when wC58A is neither 0 nor 2, wD044 bits 7 and 1 are set, and either wD045 bit 1 is clear or bit 1 is set in the actor side's byte wD057[actor / 4]; otherwise C = $FF (E-0091)

E2:6898.name: WeighWD044RuleBit1
E2:6898.note: far-calls CheckWD044RuleBit1; when it fails (C = 0) adds weight-table entry $0E to wDA70 (AccumulateBank6WordToDA70); used by the AI scoring routines (E-0091)

05:4C5D.name: CheckLoneFoeHPNotBelowAIDamageEstimates
05:4C5D.note: counts the present slots among the actor's three opposite slots (D = the last one found); when fewer than two are present and that foe's HP (GetBattleHP_Bank05) is below the word wD2C1[2 * (slot & 3)], C = 0; otherwise C = $FF. With no foe present D is not set by this routine (E-0091)

05:57CF.name: CheckFoeStatus6Bit3
05:57CF.note: C = 1 when wDA53[actor] (the AI mode) is below 3; otherwise C = 0 when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 6 (wD812) bit 3 set, else C = $FF (E-0092)

05:4777.name: AllOtherAlliesHaveStatus0Bit6
05:4777.note: looks at the actor's own three slots other than the actor: C = $FF when one of them is present with status byte 0 (wBattleStatus) bit 6 clear, or when none of them is present; otherwise (every present ally has bit 6) C = 0 (E-0092)

05:6FD9.name: FoeOfFamilyEPresent
05:6FD9.note: E = family: C = 0 when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present and its species family (GetSlotSpeciesFamily) equals E; otherwise C = $FF (E-0092)

05:6C86.name: Get2BitFieldEOfHL
05:6C86.note: E = field number: A = bits 1-0 of [HL] for field 0, bits 3-2 for 1, bits 5-4 for 2, bits 7-6 for 3 (moved down to bits 1-0) (E-0092)

05:6C02.name: SlotHasSkillWithFlagD
05:6C02.note: C = slot, D = mask: walks the slot's 8 skill numbers (every other byte of the 16 bytes at wD989 + 16 * C), loading part of each skill record into hFFC6 (LoadSkillRecordPart with wD868 = 5, wD869 = 1); returns A = hFFC6 & D for the first skill with a masked bit set, else A = 0; BC kept (E-0092)

05:5317.name: HPBandOfSlotTemp0
05:5317.note: hFFC6 = battle slot: C = 0 when its HP >= 2/3 of its max HP, 1 when >= 1/2, 2 when >= 1/3, 3 when >= 1/4, 4 when >= 1/10, else 5 (GetBattleHP_Bank05, GetBattleMaxHP_Bank05, divisions rounded down) (E-0092)

05:6198.name: CheckAIFlagSetModeGated
05:6198.note: C = 1 when wDA53[actor] (the AI mode) is below 3; otherwise C = 0 when wD2CC is non-zero, $FF when it is zero (E-0092)

1F:5D2A.name: DrawTileRectFromArg1Params
1F:5D2A.note: parameters wD7F1/wD7F2 = source (high, low), wD7F3 = width, wD7F4 = rows, wD7F5/wD7F6 = BG map destination (high, low): copies each row of tiles to the BG map with interrupts off after rSTAT bit 1 clears, wrapping columns inside the 32-entry row; on CGB, when wD7F7 is 0, also zero-fills the same entries in VRAM bank 1 (attributes); the row loop is not read to its end (E-0093)

04:431F.name: DecompressGraphicsTemp0ToTemp4
04:431F.note: hFFC6/hFFC7 = graphics number, hFFCA/hFFCB = VRAM destination: with hFFC8 = 0 the source and bank come from a 3-byte-per-entry table at $4EAA; otherwise from the word table at $43AC with bank $7D ($7E for numbers $50 and up); then DecompressToVRAM; on CGB it goes on to the palette (not read) (E-0093)

02:5923.name: SetFollowerTargetsFromLeader
02:5923.note: the three 5-byte follower records at wFollowerRecords hold direction, X, Y, target X, target Y: record 0's target = hPlayerX/hPlayerY, record 1's target = record 0's position, record 2's target = record 1's position (E-0093)

02:5946.name: StepFollowersTowardTargets
02:5946.note: unless wC94D is non-zero, moves each of the three follower records one pixel toward its target (four pixels when wC468 bit 7 is set), X first and then Y, storing the direction moved in byte 0 (1 = X increasing, 3 = X decreasing; Y directions not read to the end) (E-0093)

05:4527.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus5Bits01
05:4527.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 5 (wD811) & $03 clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask), else 0 (E-0094)

05:4539.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus5Bit0And1Bit1
05:4539.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 5 (wD811) bit 0 clear and status byte 1 (wD80D) bit 1 clear, else 0 (E-0094)

05:456B.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus5Bit1And1Bit1
05:456B.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 5 (wD811) bit 1 clear and status byte 1 (wD80D) bit 1 clear, else 0 (E-0094)

05:49DD.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 0 & $03 clear and the low 2 bits of its wDA76 entry not 3, else 0 (E-0099)

05:4A10.name: AnyFoeOpenToWDA77Field3
05:4A10.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 0 bit 6 clear and bits 7-6 of its wDA77 entry not both set, else 0 (E-0099)

05:4B7A.name: AnyOwnSideSlotOutIs1
05:4B7A.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's side's three wBattleSlotOut bytes is 1, else 0 (E-0099)

05:4CE5.name: CheckFoeStatus7Bit2
05:4CE5.note: C = 1 when the AI mode (wDA53[actor]) is below 3; otherwise C = 0 when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 7 (wD813) bit 2 set, else $FF (E-0099)

05:4D1A.name: AnyAllyLacksStatus1Bits23And4Bits01
05:4D1A.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's own three slots is present (the actor included) with status byte 1 (wD80D) & $0C clear and status byte 4 & $03 clear, else 0 (E-0099)

05:4DF5.name: CheckSide0FlagNot1
05:4DF5.note: C = 0 when the actor's side byte (wC984 for slots 0-3, wC985 for 4-7) is 1, else C = $FF (E-0099)

05:459D.name: AnyFoeLacksStatus5Bits01And1Bit1
05:459D.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 5 (wD811) & $03 clear and status byte 1 (wD80D) bit 1 clear, else 0 (E-0100)

05:4949.name: AnyFoeWithMPOpenToWDA74Field1
05:4949.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with non-zero MP (GetBattleMP_Bank05) and bits 3-2 of its wDA74 entry not both set, else 0 (E-0100)

05:4B3D.name: AtLeastTwoFoesPresent
05:4B3D.note: C = $FF when at least two of the actor's three opposite slots are present, else 0 (the opposite of FewerThanTwoFoesPresent) (E-0100)

05:53E6.name: ActorLacksStatus4Bits45
05:53E6.note: C = 0 when the actor's status byte 4 (wD810) & $30 is set, else C = $FF (E-0100)

05:558B.name: ActorMPBelowThreeQuarters
05:558B.note: C = $FF when 4 x the actor's MP is below 3 x its max MP (MP under three quarters of max), else 0 (E-0100)

05:5CCE.name: CheckBattleKindNot2Or3
05:5CCE.note: C = 0 when wCFC5 is 2 or 3, else C = $FF (E-0100)

05:5D20.name: AnyAllyLacksStatus2Bit2
05:5D20.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's own three slots (the actor included) is present with status byte 2 (wD80E) bit 2 clear (AnySlotLacksStatusMask), else 0 (E-0100)

05:5D31.name: AnyAllyLacksStatus2Bit2_5D31
05:5D31.note: the same test as AnyAllyLacksStatus2Bit2: C = $FF when one of the actor's own three slots (the actor included) is present with status byte 2 bit 2 clear. It computes the side with `and a, $04` twice where the opposite-side predicates use `and a, $04 / xor a, $04`, so it probably meant the foes (a possible slip; not executed) (E-0100)

05:5D9B.name: AnyFoeOpenToWDA74Field3
05:5D9B.note: C = $FF when one of the actor's three opposite slots is present with status byte 0 bit 7 clear and bits 7-6 of its wDA74 entry not both set, else 0 (E-0100)

05:6481.name: CheckBattleKindAtLeast2OrLinkModeSet
05:6481.note: C = 0 when wC58A is 0 and wCFC5 is below 2, else C = $FF (E-0100)

05:64CC.name: CheckActorSlot0To3OrLinkModeSet
05:64CC.note: C = 0 when wC58A is 0 and the actor is in slots 4-7, else C = $FF (E-0100)

05:6FBD.name: AnySlotHasStatusMask
05:6FBD.note: A = first slot, B = slot count, HL = a status field (wBattleStatus + n), E = mask: C = $FF when some present slot in the range has (HL + 9 * slot) & E non-zero, else C = 0 (the opposite test to AnySlotLacksStatusMask) (E-0100)

03:460B.name: MenuCursorPositions_Bank03
03:460B.note: ten BG map addresses: rows 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 and 13 of column 1 ($9861 ... $99A1) and rows 1, 3, 5 and 7 of column 9 ($9829 ... $98E9), indexed by the cursor slot (wC46D & 3 or & 7) by the bank-$03 menu cursor routines (E-0101)

03:4414.name: CopyTenBytesToTextBuf0
03:4414.note: copies 10 bytes from HL to wC130 and writes $F0 after them; HL advances; BC kept (E-0101)

03:451C.name: DrawMenuCursorTileInBuffer
03:451C.note: writes the cursor tile $BB into wScreenTileBuffer at the position of MenuCursorPositions_Bank03[wC46D & 3] (BG map address + $2998) (E-0101)

03:7692.name: LoadScreenBlock21
03:7692.note: clears the screen tile buffer (ClearScreenTileBuffer_Bank03) and copies block $21 into it (CopyBlockToTileBuffer, E = $21) (E-0101)

03:769E.name: LoadScreenBlock21WithCursor
03:769E.note: LoadScreenBlock21, then writes tile $BC at MenuCursorPositions_Bank03[wC46D & 7] in the buffer (WriteBCTileToScreenBufferAtTableEntry_Bank03) (E-0101)

03:641E.name: LoadScreenBlocks1CAnd0C
03:641E.note: clears the screen tile buffer and copies blocks $1C and $0C into it (CopyBlockToTileBuffer) (E-0101)

03:5900.name: ShowSelectedItemDescription
03:5900.note: inventory slot = (wMenuPage & $0F) * 4 + (wC46E & $0F): shows that item's string of category 6 (the item descriptions of the bank-$08 database; item $1F uses string $6F) at vTiles2 + $230 with size $1203 (ShowStringBank08AtTilesHL_Bank03) (E-0101)

30:4F14.name: RunHandlersForSetBitsInBC
30:4F14.note: for bit numbers 0-15 in turn (BitMaskWords16): when the bit is set in BC (C for 0-7, B for 8-15), calls handler E through CallFlagBitHandlerE; stops early when a handler returns carry (E-0102)

30:4F3B.name: CallFlagBitHandlerE
30:4F3B.note: E = bit number: jumps through the 16-word handler table at $4F66 (JumpToWordAtHL) (E-0102)

16:4B4D.name: AddAToRecordWordCapped
16:4B4D.note: A = amount, record wD083 (SRAMRecordAddressMapped), field offset C: the word there += A, capped at 999 (CapDETo999) (E-0103)

16:4B68.name: AddAToRecordWordPairCapped
16:4B68.note: A = amount, record wD083 (SRAMRecordAddressMapped), field offset C: adds A to the word at field C and to the word two bytes before it, each capped at 999 (E-0103)

16:4B97.name: SubtractAFromRecordWordFloor1
16:4B97.note: A = amount, record wD083 (SRAMRecordAddressMapped), field offset C: leaves the word unchanged when it is 999; otherwise word -= A, but never below 1 (E-0103)

16:4BC4.name: SubtractAFromRecordWordPairFloor1
16:4BC4.note: A = amount, record wD083 (SRAMRecordAddressMapped), field offset C: as SubtractAFromRecordWordFloor1 for the word at field C, then the same for the word two bytes before it (the second half is not read to its end) (E-0103)

16:466A.name: ShowRaiseAmountOrRefuse
16:466A.note: HL = cap, BC = current value: when they are equal sets wItemId = $FF (refuse); otherwise writes min(HL - BC, wD08F) (wD08F when the difference is 256 or more) as a decimal string at wC160 (WriteDecimalByteString) (E-0103)

16:58FD.name: StoreHLToRecordField
16:58FD.note: A = record (SRAMRecordAddressMapped), C = field offset: stores HL (low byte first) at that field (E-0103)

16:66B9.name: BlankTileAtTableEntryDE
16:66B9.note: HL = table of VRAM addresses, [DE] = index: writes tile $C3 at that entry's address (WriteVRAMByte); HL kept (E-0103)

16:7A97.name: LoadTileForRecordByte0D
16:7A97.note: A = record (SRAMRecordAddressMapped, offset $0D), H = destination page: picks 16 bytes from Data_016_7ACD by the low nibble of record byte $0D and copies them on through the shared copy loop at Jump_016_7AB2 (not read to its end) (E-0103)

16:7A64.name: LoadTilesForPartyRecords
16:7A64.note: with SRAM enabled (bank 0), runs LoadTileForRecordByte0D for record list entries 0, 1 and 2 with H = $C7, $C8 and $C9, stopping after wC6FD entries; then disables SRAM (E-0103)

1D:5E3F.name: CountRecordsInUse
1D:5E3F.note: over the first wD7FF SRAM records ($A5 bytes each from sA000; wD7FF is set by LoadRecordCapacityFromFarmLevelTable): wD7AA = how many have byte 0 equal to 1 or 2 (in use) (E-0104)

1D:5ECE.name: ListRecordsState1WithByte6EClear
1D:5ECE.note: over the first wD7FF SRAM records ($A5 bytes each from sA000; wD7FF is set by LoadRecordCapacityFromFarmLevelTable): clears the 30-byte list wD789, then appends the number of every record whose byte 0 is 1 and byte $6E is 0; wD7A9 = the list length, wD7B9 = how many state-1 records had byte $6E set (E-0104)

1D:5F2D.name: ListRecordsInUseWithByte6EClear
1D:5F2D.note: over the first wD7FF SRAM records ($A5 bytes each from sA000; wD7FF is set by LoadRecordCapacityFromFarmLevelTable): clears wD789 and wD7BE (30 bytes each), then appends every record whose byte 0 is 1 or 2 and byte $6E is 0; wD7A9 = the list length, wD7B9 = how many in-use records had byte $6E set (E-0104)

1D:6026.name: ListRecordsInUseWithByte6ESet
1D:6026.note: over the first wD7FF SRAM records ($A5 bytes each from sA000; wD7FF is set by LoadRecordCapacityFromFarmLevelTable): clears wD789, then appends every record whose byte 0 is 1 or 2 and byte $6E is non-zero; wD7A9 = the list length (E-0104)

1D:7AD8.name: UnpackByteAtHLTo2BitFieldsArg5
1D:7AD8.note: with SRAM bank wD7F2 selected, splits the byte at HL into four 2-bit fields: wD7F5 = bits 7-6, wD7F6 = bits 5-4, wD7F7 = bits 3-2, wD7F8 = bits 1-0 (E-0104)

1D:70F9.name: Pack2BitFieldsFromPackFields
1D:70F9.note: B = (wD7E2 & 3) << 6 | (wD7E3 & 3) << 4 | (wD7E4 & 3) << 2 | (wD7E5 & 3), the opposite of unpacking a byte into four 2-bit fields (E-0104)

1D:58C8.name: DrawThreeDigitsAtScrollOffset6E
1D:58C8.note: writes the three bytes at wD7CE as digit tiles ($E0 + digit) at the BG map entry BGMapAddressAtScroll + $6E (row 3, column 14 of the view), one per byte with WaitForVRAMAccess (E-0104)

1D:6973.name: DecompressGraphicsArg1ToArg4
1D:6973.note: graphics number = the word wD7F1/wD7F2: reads its far pointer (3 bytes per entry) from Data_004_4EAA in bank $04 (ReadFarPointerAtDEInBankB) and DecompressToVRAM to the address in wD7F4/wD7F5; on CGB it continues with the palette (not read) (E-0104)

1D:65F6.name: UpdateListCursorListCursor
1D:65F6.note: list cursor over wD7A9 entries: Up/Down move wD7AB with wrap, erase and redraw the cursor, play sound $69 and set wMenuInputResult = $FD; A draws the confirmed cursor, plays sound $69 and sets $FF; B sets $FE; with no input the cursor blinks and the result is 0 (the codes of UpdatePagedListCursor) (E-0106)

1D:62AD.name: DrawRecordListNameTiles_Bank1D
1D:62AD.note: with SRAM enabled, for each of the wC6FD record numbers in wC6FE copies the record's name (CopyRecordNameToNameGlyphBuf, C = 1) and draws it as glyph tiles at the VRAM address from Data_01D_62F9 (CopyGlyphTilesToVRAM); then disables SRAM (E-0106)

1D:75C7.name: CopyTenBytesThenSelectSRAMBank0
1D:75C7.note: copies 10 bytes from HL to DE, selecting SRAM bank 0 (rRAMB = 0) after each byte is read; HL and DE advance (E-0106)

12:7DF1.name: RemoveInventorySlotShiftDown
12:7DF1.note: hFFC6 = inventory slot: moves each wInventory byte after it down by one up to slot $17 (the last slot keeps its old value), then wC634 = $FF; nothing moves when the slot is $17 (E-0106)

15:683C.name: SubtractArg1AmountFromGold
15:683C.note: wGold -= the 24-bit amount wD7F3:wD7F2:wD7F1 (no floor; callers check first, for example with IsAmountInArg1AboveGold) (E-0106)

15:6676.name: UnpackBCDToDigitsArg1
15:6676.note: wD7F1 = hFFC9, then the high and low digits of hFFC8, hFFC7 and hFFC6 go to wD7F2-wD7F7 (seven digits of a packed-BCD number, most significant first); the loop that follows (C = 6) is not read (E-0106)

1E:7564.name: DrawPageOfPagesAtScrollOffset
1E:7564.note: HL = BGMapAddressAtScroll + the offset in wD7F1 (high) / wD7F2 (low): writes tile $E0 + wD7AF + 1 there and tile $E0 + wD7B0 two entries later, each through StepBGMapAddressBackOnScrollWrap and WaitForVRAMAccess (current page and page count) (E-0106)

F1:4870.name: UpdateMenuCursor_BankF1
F1:4870.note: the same instruction sequence as UpdateMenuCursor (bank $03) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

F1:42D9.name: ShowSelectedItemDescription_BankF1
F1:42D9.note: the same instruction sequence as ShowSelectedItemDescription (bank $03) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

05:6312.name: HPBandOfSlotTemp0_6312
05:6312.note: the same instruction sequence as HPBandOfSlotTemp0 (bank $05) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

1B:665E.name: EggServiceMenu_Bank1B
1B:665E.note: the same instruction sequence as EggServiceMenu (bank $0D) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

F0:6384.name: DrawPageOfPagesAtScrollOffset_BankF0
F0:6384.note: the same instruction sequence as DrawPageOfPagesAtScrollOffset (bank $1E) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

A1:413F.name: RunBattleCommandEntry_BankA1
A1:413F.note: the same instruction sequence as RunBattleCommandEntry (bank $30) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

A0:5E07.name: RunBattleSetup_BankA0
A0:5E07.note: the same instruction sequence as RunBattleSetup (bank $31) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

3B:4AB2.name: RollChanceByLevel_100_100_75_0_Bank3B
3B:4AB2.note: the same instruction sequence as RollChanceByLevel_100_100_75_0 (bank $36) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

7F:40CC.name: DrawMetaSpriteAt_40CC
7F:40CC.note: the same instruction sequence as DrawMetaSpriteAt (bank $7F) apart from label operands, which refer to this bank's own routines and tables; the twin's note describes the shape (E-0107)

00:11DA.name: DarkenDMGPaletteByFadeLevel
00:11DA.note: A = a DMG palette byte (four 2-bit shades): each shade + wFadeLevel, capped at 3 (black), is packed back and stored at [HL] (DarkenDMGShade and DarkenDMGShadeNext) (E-0108)

00:11F5.name: DarkenDMGShade
00:11F5.note: adds B (the level) to the 2-bit shade in A & 3, caps it at 3, ORs it into C and rotates C right by 2 (E-0108)

00:11F0.name: DarkenDMGShadeNext
00:11F0.note: rotates D right by 2 to bring the next shade down, then DarkenDMGShade (E-0108)

00:1145.name: LightenDMGPaletteByFadeLevel
00:1145.note: A = a DMG palette byte: each 2-bit shade - wFadeLevel, at least 0 (white), is packed back and stored at [HL] (LightenDMGShade and LightenDMGShadeNext) (E-0108)

00:1160.name: LightenDMGShade
00:1160.note: subtracts B (the level) from the 2-bit shade in A & 3 (at least 0), ORs it into C and rotates C right by 2 (E-0108)

00:115B.name: LightenDMGShadeNext
00:115B.note: rotates D right by 2 to bring the next shade down, then LightenDMGShade (E-0108)

00:076B.name: ClearSGBPacketBuffer
00:076B.note: zero-fills the 16 bytes of wSGBPacketBuffer; BC, HL kept (E-0108)

00:08A6.name: ClearSTATInterruptSources
00:08A6.note: rSTAT &= $07: clears the LCD-status interrupt source bits 3-6, keeping the mode and coincidence flags (E-0108)

00:07D1.name: WaitSerialTransferDone
00:07D1.note: waits until rSC bit 7 (transfer in progress) clears (E-0108)

00:1F95.name: LoadRecordThreeBytesToTemp0
00:1F95.note: A = record, C = field offset (SRAMRecordAddress): copies three bytes from the record to hFFC6-hFFC8; HL kept (E-0108)

00:1022.name: CopySGBPacketFieldsAndSend
00:1022.note: copies 8 bytes from HL to DE, skips 2 source bytes, copies 6 more, then wSGBPacketIndex = $FF and far-calls SendSGBPacketSet (E-0108)

02:706E.name: CheckSaveData
02:706E.note: with SRAM bank 1 selected: hFFC6 = 1 when sBB00 is not the signature $55 (no save); otherwise 2 when VerifySaveBank1Checksum or VerifySaveBank3Checksum returns non-zero (damaged save), else 0 (valid); then disables SRAM (E-0109)

02:70A2.name: VerifySaveBank1Checksum
02:70A2.note: sums the SRAM bank-1 bytes from sA06F into the word DE (the loop adds several bytes per pass; the comparison at the end is not read) and returns A non-zero on a mismatch, as CheckSaveData uses it (E-0109)

02:7111.name: VerifySaveBank3Checksum
02:7111.note: sums the SRAM bank-3 bytes from sA000 into the word DE (comparison not read) and returns A non-zero on a mismatch, as CheckSaveData uses it (E-0109)

02:72B0.name: CopySaveBlocksToSRAM
02:72B0.note: with SRAM bank 1 selected, walks the list at Data_002_75F7 (word address, word length; a zero address ends it) and copies each WRAM block to SRAM from sBB01 onward (the copy loop is not read to its end) (E-0109)

02:7598.name: CopySaveBlocksToSRAMWithSum
02:7598.note: the same walk of Data_002_75F7 into SRAM from sBB01, also clearing the running sum in hFFC8/hFFC9 (accumulation not read to its end) (E-0109)

02:755E.name: SnapshotSpritesForSave
02:755E.note: wC83A = wCB7E and the $50 bytes of wSpriteSlots go to wC83B; then clears bit 1 of five object flag bytes at wC848, wC858, wC868, wC878 and wC888 (E-0109)

02:717D.name: RunSaveSteps
02:717D.note: with SRAM enabled, steps by wC8C3: on the first call (0) sets it to 1 and runs CopySaveBlocksToSRAM and three more save routines; on the second runs Func_002_71B2; afterwards sets bit 7 of wC8C3 (finished); disables SRAM each time (E-0109)

31:778E.name: ReadWordTableEntryForSlotC
31:778E.note: HL = table: HL = the word at HL + 2 * (C & 3) (falls into DerefHL_Bank31) (E-0110)

31:7797.name: DerefHL_Bank31
31:7797.note: HL = the word at HL; A = its low byte (E-0110)

31:7379.name: LoadMonsterPictureAttributesFromDE
31:7379.note: hFFC6 = C (palette number), DE = the monster id word stored at [DE], then LoadMonsterPictureAttributes (HL = BG map address from the caller); DE kept (E-0110)

31:7509.name: DrawWC2A4AndWC2B8Rects
31:7509.note: copies a 7 x 1 rectangle from wC2A4 to vBGMap0 + $10C (row 8, column 12) and a 20 x 9 rectangle from wC2B8 to vBGMap0 + $120 (row 9), both with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM (E-0110)

31:74A0.name: DrawWC278Rect12x11ToBGMapRow7
31:74A0.note: copies a 12 x 11 rectangle from wC278 (rows 32 bytes apart) to vBGMap0 + $E0 (row 7) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM (E-0110)

31:71F5.name: ClearAttributesAndScreenBuffer_Bank31
31:71F5.note: on CGB writes 0 to the 20 x 18 visible attributes of vBGMap0 in VRAM bank 1 (rows 32 apart, WriteVRAMByteInc); then fills the $240 bytes of wScreenTileBuffer with $C3; what follows is not read (E-0110)

31:6DDD.name: ShowStringHL_Bank31
31:6DDD.note: wStringCategory = H, wStringIndex = L, then far-calls BeginStringDisplay_Bank2F (E-0110)

31:6286.name: ReturnZero_6286
31:6286.note: A = 0 (xor a, so Z set and carry clear); a two-byte handler stub (E-0110)

31:61A2.name: ReturnZero_61A2
31:61A2.note: A = 0 (xor a, so Z set and carry clear); a two-byte handler stub (E-0110)

31:7806.name: DrawSlotHPDigits
31:7806.note: C = battle slot, drawn only for the displayed side (slots 0-2 normally, 4-6 when wC58A = 1 and wC57F bit 1 is set; slots 3 and 7 never); with wC58A = 2 the bank-$A0 version is far-called instead: writes the slot's HP (wBattleHP) as decimal digit tiles (HLToDecimalDigits) into wScreenTileBuffer at the position from Data_031_7AC8 (E-0111)

31:785F.name: DrawSlotMPDigits
31:785F.note: C = battle slot, drawn only for the displayed side (slots 0-2 normally, 4-6 when wC58A = 1 and wC57F bit 1 is set; slots 3 and 7 never); with wC58A = 2 the bank-$A0 version is far-called instead: writes the slot's MP (wBattleMP) as decimal digit tiles into wScreenTileBuffer at the slot's position (E-0111)

31:77B9.name: CopySlotPanelRowToVRAM
31:77B9.note: C = battle slot, drawn only for the displayed side (slots 0-2 normally, 4-6 when wC58A = 1 and wC57F bit 1 is set; slots 3 and 7 never); with wC58A = 2 the bank-$A0 version is far-called instead: copies the slot's 5-tile panel row from wScreenTileBuffer to the same position of vBGMap0 (offset from Data_031_7ADA, WriteVRAMByteInc) (E-0111)

31:76AE.name: DrawSlotStatusMarks
31:76AE.note: C = battle slot, drawn only for the displayed side (slots 0-2 normally, 4-6 when wC58A = 1 and wC57F bit 1 is set; slots 3 and 7 never); with wC58A = 2 the bank-$A0 version is far-called instead: draws the slot's status markers from its status bytes (the per-status part is not read to its end) (E-0111)

A0:6B46.name: DrawSlotHPDigits_BankA0
A0:6B46.note: C = slot 0-2: writes the slot's HP as decimal digit tiles into wScreenTileBuffer at the position from Data_0A0_6D47 (the wC58A = 2 form of DrawSlotHPDigits) (E-0111)

A0:6B79.name: DrawSlotMPDigits_BankA0
A0:6B79.note: C = slot 0-2: writes the slot's MP as decimal digit tiles into wScreenTileBuffer at the position from Data_0A0_6D4B (the wC58A = 2 form of DrawSlotMPDigits) (E-0111)

A0:6B1E.name: CopySlotPanelRowToVRAM_BankA0
A0:6B1E.note: C = slot 0-2: copies the 5-tile panel row at Data_0A0_6D53's offset from wScreenTileBuffer to vBGMap0 (the wC58A = 2 form of CopySlotPanelRowToVRAM) (E-0111)

A0:6A45.name: DrawSlotStatusMarks_BankA0
A0:6A45.note: C = slot 0-2: when the slot is present and its status byte 0 is non-zero, calls one marker routine for each of bits 0, 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7 that is set (the zero-status path is not read) (E-0111)

A0:591A.name: WriteUnknownNamePlaceholder
A0:591A.note: writes '???' ($98 three times, the charmap '?') followed by seven $F0 bytes at HL: a 10-byte name field holding a placeholder (E-0111)

A0:6871.name: ReturnZero_6871
A0:6871.note: A = 0 (xor a); a two-byte handler stub (E-0111)

A0:4C9B.name: DrawWC2B8Rect11x9ToBGMapRow9_BankA0
A0:4C9B.note: copies an 11 x 9 rectangle from wC2B8 to vBGMap0 + $120 (row 9) with CopyRect32StrideToVRAM_BankA0 (E-0111)

A0:6BB3.name: DrawSlotLevel_BankA0
A0:6BB3.note: C = slot 0-2: writes tiles $EA, $AF (not in the charmap; probably a level mark) into wScreenTileBuffer at the position from Data_0A0_6D4F, then the value wD8B7[slot] as digits (probably the level; the digit part is not read to its end) (E-0111)

E0:47F0.name: DrawBits10OfDEAsDigit
E0:47F0.note: writes bits 1-0 of [DE] as digit tile $E0 + value (0-3) at HL (WriteVRAMByteInc) (E-0112)

E0:47EB.name: DrawBits32OfDEAsDigit
E0:47EB.note: writes bits 3-2 of [DE] as digit tile $E0 + value (0-3) at HL (WriteVRAMByteInc) (E-0112)

E0:4F28.name: DrawSlotStatusBitsDebug
E0:4F28.note: debug: draws the four-tile strip for wC5FE, then the 9 status bytes of slot wC5FE as rows of 0/1 digit tiles from vBGMap0 + $89 (E-0127)

E0:74D8.name: StepSpriteSlotTowardDE
E0:74D8.note: moves sprite slot A's position bytes toward D and E by the steps $7535/$7542 indexed by wD0A7; NZ while still moving (E-0127)

F0:63EE.name: CopyScreenBufferRectWithAttrs_F0
F0:63EE.note: copies a wD7F1 x wD7F2 block inside the screen buffer from offset DE to offset HL, C rows, with CGB attributes (E-0127)

F1:58FA.name: CopyScreenBufferRectWithAttrs_F1
F1:58FA.note: copies a wD7F1 x wD7F2 block inside the screen buffer from offset DE to offset HL, C rows, with CGB attributes (E-0127)

F0:6709.name: HandleTwoChoiceCursorInput_F0
F0:6709.note: up/down moves wD7B7 between two entries (sound $69); A selects (wMenuInputResult = $FF), B cancels ($FE); otherwise blinks the cursor (E-0127)

F1:5842.name: HandleThreeChoiceCursorInput_F1
F1:5842.note: up/down moves wTwoChoiceCursor over three entries (wMenuInputResult = $FD), A and B select or cancel; otherwise blinks the cursor (E-0127)

F2:4E76.name: DecompressRecordBufBSpeciesGraphics
F2:4E76.note: for the three species words of wCA2B (offsets Data_0F2_4F41 or 4F44 by bit 4 of wCA38) decompresses their graphics to the targets in Data_0F2_4ED4 (E-0127)

F2:4EDD.name: DrawRecordBufBSpeciesSprites
F2:4EDD.note: for the three species words of wCA2B draws their sprite parts at the positions in Data_0F2_4F35 (E-0127)

F2:50E2.name: DrawFamilyIconAndCountForWCA38
F2:50E2.note: loads the family icon of wCA38 & $0F into tile wD7F4; the next entry draws tile $1E and the count wCA2B[wD7F1] at the scroll offset wD7F2/3 (E-0127)

00:0535.name: LinkExchangeJoypadPerFrame
00:0535.note: in link mode: counts frames (resetting the game after an overflow), saves the joypad state and starts the next serial transfer of the queued byte or the joypad (E-0128)

00:10AB.name: AdjustColorChannelForFade
00:10AB.note: A = the 5-bit colour channel A moved by B toward white or black (bit 7 of wC56D), clamped; the following entries step the CGB and DMG fades (E-0128)

00:1C0C.name: LoadMapHeader
00:1C0C.note: loads the current map's graphics, palette, size (wMapWidthScreens/HeightScreens), wMaxBlockingTile and other header bytes from the bank-$11 map record (special maps use LoadMapHeaderByMapType) (E-0128)

00:2038.name: LoadMonsterPictureAttributeBlock
00:2038.note: copies the 6 x 6 picture attribute block of species DE (table $447E in bank $38, default $20E9) plus hFFC6 to HL in WRAM bank 2 (E-0128)

01:5AC0.name: DrawDebugFieldValueDebugCursor
01:5AC0.note: debug: draws the value of field wC5F8 (Data_001_5B70) at Data_001_5B84[wC5F8] as hex, a tile or BCD (E-0128)

02:665A.name: DrawGoldDigitsAtHLWrapped
02:665A.note: writes the gold as up to five decimal digit tiles without leading zeros at HL in VRAM, wrapping at the row end (E-0128)

02:71ED.name: RestoreRecordsFromSRAMBank1Backup
02:71ED.note: copies the record backup at sAD71 (SRAM bank 1) back to sB356 in bank 0 and to sA000 in bank 1; counterpart of BackupRecordsToSRAMBank1 (E-0128)

03:7A58.name: ComputeMenuPagesForPauseListCountItems
03:7A58.note: from wD0C7 items computes wMenuPageCount (4 rows per page, up to 8 pages), wMenuLastPageRows and wMenuRowCount for wMenuPage, and draws the page indicator (E-0128)

04:4AA8.name: LoadPlayerAndFollowerSpriteGraphics
04:4AA8.note: hFF8B = sprite mode from story flags $19F, $25 and 2 and bit 3 of hFF8C, then loads the matching player and follower sprite graphics (E-0128)

05:5052.name: PassIfFoesAverageResistanceAtLeast2
05:5052.note: C = $FF when wCFEF is 0 or the occupied foes' average resistance level for skill wCFEF is at least 2, else $00 (E-0128)

05:517D.name: PassIfTwiceATKAboveLowestFoeDEF
05:517D.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 2; otherwise $FF when the lowest DEF among occupied foes is below twice the actor's ATK, else $00 (E-0128)

05:5500.name: FailIfFoeSkill3DThreatensActorHP
05:5500.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 2; otherwise $00 when a foe knowing skill $3D has 2 * MP + 2 * wD8B7 at least the actor's HP, else $FF (E-0128)

05:59BD.name: FailIfAllyLacksMPForHealSkill
05:59BD.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 3; otherwise $00 when another able ally knows a skill $16-$1A but has less MP than its cost (Data_005_5A33), else $FF (E-0128)

05:604C.name: FailIfFoeHurtAndHealerCanCast
05:604C.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 4; otherwise $00 when an occupied foe has HP at most half and a foe with personality Lo >= $C0 can cast a heal (Func_005_60BA), else $FF (E-0128)

05:60BA.name: SlotCHasCastableHealSkill
05:60BA.note: carry unless slot C has a heal skill ($16-$1A, $7B, $7C or $A1) that its status allows, is not the queued action, and whose MP cost (Data_005_614B) it can pay (E-0128)

05:69F5.name: ResistanceAverageGateForAISide
05:69F5.note: C = 1 for the player side outside link battles; otherwise like PassIfFoesAverageResistanceAtLeast2 (E-0128)

05:6A6B.name: ResistanceAverageGateForFoeAIMode3
05:6A6B.note: C = 1 in link battles, for the player side, or when the AI mode is below 3; otherwise like PassIfFoesAverageResistanceAtLeast2 (E-0128)

07:600E.name: ResetLinkScreenPalettes
07:600E.note: sets the DMG palettes $D2/$D2/$E2 (also in wD040) and resets the fade; on the Super Game Boy blanks rBGP/rOBP, sends PAL_SET for wC51F and copies 8 bytes from $58FA to wC4FF (E-0128)

0A:47A4.name: StartScriptedEncounterTemp0
0A:47A4.note: loads encounter entry $481C + 8 * hFFC6 into wCFDC-wCFE2, sets the battle intro (wC903 = 2, or 7 for entries $14, $15, $2F-$31), mode state 3 and the battle transition (E-0128)

0C:724F.name: PickTableEntryByPartyLevelTotal
0C:724F.note: HL = the word Data_00C_72C0[band] for the party's total level (bands at 49, 91, 139, 181, 220 and 256) (E-0128)

0C:72CC.name: CopyScreenBufferRectWithAttrs_0C
0C:72CC.note: copies a wD7F1 x wD7F2 block inside the screen buffer from offset DE to offset HL for rows B to C, with CGB attributes (E-0128)

0E:5F91.name: PersonalityPairValueToArg5
0E:5F91.note: wD7F5 = the 2-bit entry of the matrix Data_00E_603F for the combined personality indexes of wC986 and wCA2B (E-0128)

0E:615A.name: FamilyForSpeciesIdArg6
0E:615A.note: wD7F5 = the family (0-10) of species id wD7F6/7 by id ranges (< $1B, $43, $67, $85, $A8, $CA, $F1, $111, $139, $15C, or more) (E-0128)

12:70A4.name: FindTriggerEntryForCurrentScreen
12:70A4.note: wC8FE = $FF; on town maps (or special maps of type 0) finds the wCC48 entry for the current screen and sets wC900, wC8FF and wC8FE from it (E-0128)

12:710A.name: FindTriggerEntryForCurrentScreen_ScreenTriggers
12:710A.note: on maps from $30 (or special map $85) finds the wCCEB entry for the current screen and sets wC900, wC8FF and wC8FE from it (E-0128)

12:75E0.name: RunPeriodicFieldEventChecks
12:75E0.note: on town maps, every 100 calls (wC832), tries the gold, party-stat and digit events in turn until one sets wC935 (E-0128)

12:77AC.name: TriggerEventC9IfExpDigitsRepeat
12:77AC.note: with at least 1000 gold: when a party member's EXP has its last three decimal digits equal, wC935 = $C9 and carry (E-0128)

12:781E.name: TriggerEventForStatusedMemberHP_781E
12:781E.note: with at least 1000 gold: checks party members with status bits 7, 2 or 0 of field $55 against half their max HP and may set an event (E-0128)

12:79DC.name: TriggerEventC3IfGoldDigitSum30
12:79DC.note: with at least 5000 gold and wC634 $FF or 0: when the gold's decimal digits sum to at least 30, wC935 = $C3 and carry (E-0128)

12:7A4D.name: TriggerEventC2IfPartyHPLastDigitsMatch
12:7A4D.note: with at least 1000 gold: when every party member's HP ends in the same decimal digit, wC935 = $C2 and carry (E-0128)

12:7AD0.name: TriggerEventC1IfGoldDigitSumAtMost12
12:7AD0.note: with at least 1000 gold and wC634 $FF or 0: when the gold's decimal digits sum to at most 12, wC935 = $C1 and carry (E-0128)

12:7CD9.name: RollFieldEventOnTallTiles
12:7CD9.note: on map type 1, standing on tiles at or above wC196, a 1-in-8 roll sets event $0A in wC935 unless item $2C is owned or the gold is below 100; then A = 1 when any tile under the player is blocking (E-0128)

12:7E0F.name: FindPartyMemberWithSkill76To7DOr92
12:7E0F.note: hFFC7 = the index of the first party member knowing skill $76-$7D or $92 and hFFC8 = that skill, or hFFC7 = $80 (E-0128)

16:590C.name: SortInventory
16:590C.note: toggles the sort order in wC836 and sorts the 24 inventory slots by the key table Data_016_599E or Data_016_5A0E (empty slots last) (E-0128)

16:6705.name: DrawRecordListPageWithNumbers
16:6705.note: shows five record names of page wCFD1 at vTiles2 + $3B0 and the slot numbers ($E1-$E3) or marks ($B6) beside them (E-0128)

19:48B1.name: ScaleStatAndCapByBattleKind
19:48B1.note: scales the word hFFC8 by 101 percent and caps it at 999, 600 or 700 depending on wD868 and the battle kind wCFC5, then stores it (E-0128)

1B:468A.name: LinkSendStepWithBuffer
1B:468A.note: link: sends $F9 when not connected; otherwise reads the received byte, polls the joypad and sends the queued byte or the next byte of the transfer buffer wC590 (E-0128)

1B:4736.name: LinkReceiveStepWithBuffer
1B:4736.note: link: reads the received byte; stores it in the transfer buffer wC590 while bytes remain, else as the remote joypad; handles the $F3 resync (E-0128)

1B:7537.name: DrawPickedRecordsRecordNamesAndIcons
1B:7537.note: for up to wD7DC records listed at wD7DD draws each name at Data_01B_75A8[n] and loads its family icon into tile Data_01B_75B0[n] (E-0128)

1C:4395.name: DrawGoldDigitsAtHLWrapped_1C
1C:4395.note: writes the gold as up to five decimal digit tiles without leading zeros at HL in VRAM, wrapping at the row end (E-0128)

1C:6919.name: RemoveItemCountFromInventory
1C:6919.note: removes 10 * wD7CA + wD7CB copies of the selected item (wD7D5[4 * wD7B6 + wD7B5]) from the inventory and compacts it (E-0128)

1D:5B4D.name: DrawRecordStatsBoxForArg1
1D:5B4D.note: record wD7F1 (bank 1): writes its mark (field $0E), level (field $56) and four stat words (fields from Data_01D_5BE6) into the screen buffer (E-0128)

1D:64D6.name: HandleListCursorInput_1D
1D:64D6.note: up/down moves wD7AB over wD7A9 entries ($FD), A selects ($FF, sound $69), B cancels ($FE); wD7AF = 0 (E-0128)

1D:682A.name: LoadPartySpeciesSpriteGraphics
1D:682A.note: for the three records listed at wD7F1 loads each species' sprite graphics and palette to the slots in Data_01D_6890 (E-0128)

1D:6899.name: DrawPartySpeciesSprites
1D:6899.note: for the three records listed at wD7F1 draws each species sprite at the positions in Data_01D_6909 (E-0128)

1D:6AA5.name: MarkPartyMembersInRecordListPage
1D:6AA5.note: for each party record found on the current list page (wD789 page wD7AF) draws a party mark at its row (scroll offsets Data_01D_6B28 when wD7F1 is set, else screen-buffer offsets Data_01D_6B1E) (E-0128)

1D:6C14.name: LoadTileListSixPerCall
1D:6C14.note: copies tiles listed at the address in wD7F3/4 to wD7F1/2 + 16 * n, six per call; wD7F5 = $FF when the $FF end is reached, else 0 (E-0128)

1F:5C15.name: DrawRecordListPageNames
1F:5C15.note: for the visible entries of record-list page wD7AF draws each record name at Data_01F_5C9C[n] (the fifth through the mark-overlay drawer) (E-0128)

1F:73EC.name: DrawWCA36MonsterPictureInTwoSteps
1F:73EC.note: first call: draws the 6 x 6 frame Data_01F_651B and loads the picture of species wCA36 at vTiles2 + $200; second call: loads its CGB attributes and draws the picture (E-0128)

1F:76B5.name: DrawSummaryFrames6E47And6D6F
1F:76B5.note: draws the tile rectangles Data_01F_6E47 and Data_01F_6D6F, clears tile rows and sets up the summary text window (E-0128)

30:483F.name: SortThreeAIWeightsRandomTies
30:483F.note: sorts wDA3C-wDA3E in descending order (ties broken by the random bits in wC5E7/8), swapping the matching wDA3F-wDA41 entries (E-0128)

31:7105.name: ShowSelectedSkillNameAndCost
31:7105.note: shows the name (category 9) of skill wD09D[4 * page + row] at vTiles2 + $260, loads its record and writes its MP cost (or the record's MP for skills $3D, $20, $7B) as digits at wC39E (E-0128)

32:4C9C.name: RollStatusTickEffect
32:4C9C.note: a random roll: 3/4 of the time nothing; otherwise clears status 3 (text $0F), loses a sixth of max HP (text $10) or of max MP, or does something else (E-0128)

32:4D99.name: PickRandomActionWhenUncontrolled
32:4D99.note: for an actor with status bits $C0 or $0C forces action $C9; otherwise picks action $C0, $C1 or a table action (Data_032_4E1C or 4E20) at random and stores it (E-0128)

32:5397.name: PayActorMPCost
32:5397.note: subtracts the skill's MP cost (wRecordBufferData) from the actor's MP; cost $FF takes all MP and saves it in wD866; marks the MP digits for redraw (E-0128)

32:55EE.name: CheckLinkRuleViolation
32:55EE.note: in link battles with rules on: an action forbidden by the wD044/wD045 rules (Data_032_5688) ends the battle with music 2 and a message for the side that broke it (E-0128)

36:4E26.name: LoadBattleMonsterPictureForSlotB
36:4E26.note: loads the picture of battle slot B (species at DE) into its picture area at vTiles2 + $140 + $240 * position and, on CGB, its attributes (E-0128)

36:5360.name: RaiseTargetDEF
36:5360.note: raises the target's DEF by a third (half for action $25) of its base DEF, limited by the buff cap; the actual gain is stored as damage (E-0128)

36:5441.name: RaiseTargetAGL
36:5441.note: raises the target's AGL by a third (half for action $29) of its base AGL, limited by the buff cap; the actual gain is stored as damage (E-0128)

37:5172.name: StoreReceivedRecordIntoSRAM
37:5172.note: when text is idle and not linking: copies the $A5-byte received record at wCAD0 into the record slot at WD789 cell 5 and resets the save counters (E-0128)

37:5A5D.name: CopyScreenBufferRectWithAttrs_37
37:5A5D.note: copies a wD7F1 x wD7F2 block inside the screen buffer from offset DE to offset HL for rows B to C, with CGB attributes (E-0128)

3A:5536.name: UploadBGPalettesWithFade
3A:5536.note: on CGB, when wC5E9 changed, writes the eight background palettes through Func_03A_55BB (rBGPI $80-$B8) (E-0128)

3A:6846.name: RunMultiHitCounter
3A:6846.note: sets up and counts down the multi-hit counter in wDABA (1 or 3 hits for action $63), choosing a new target for $63 when the old one is gone (E-0128)

3A:77D3.name: CheckAllTargetsSame
3A:77D3.note: counts equal pairs among the hFFC6 target words at wC0A0 (or wC0A8 for the foe side); when not all are equal writes a message to wC130 (E-0128)

60:4597.name: RollKeyWorldEncounterTable
60:4597.note: clears wCE7B ($10 bytes) and fills a 4-byte entry per map area (from wCD7B) with a random monster id and level from the band lists (E-0128)

60:5075.name: ReadKeyWorldCellIsSolid
60:5075.note: reads the cell at (hFFC9, hFFCA) from the area map chunk in wCD60; A = 1 when its byte is not $FF, else 0 (E-0128)

E0:75BF.name: ResetScreenPalettes_E0
E0:75BF.note: sets the DMG palettes $D2/$D2/$E2 (also in wD040) and resets the fade; on the Super Game Boy blanks rBGP/rOBP, sends PAL_SET for wC51F and copies 8 bytes from $7641 to wC4FF (E-0128)

02:452C.name: WriteCGBObjPaletteFromDMGShadesDMGPaletteOBP0
02:452C.note: writes four colours of the palette at HL to rOBPD, each chosen by a 2-bit shade of wC5EA through Data_002_45C2; HL += 8 (E-0129)

02:4628.name: InitFieldScreen
02:4628.note: enters the field: loads the map header, resets scroll and timers, reorders the party, loads names and sprites, finds triggers, draws the map screen and places objects (E-0129)

02:5F9B.name: SendSGBFieldPaletteSet
02:5F9B.note: on the Super Game Boy sends PAL_SET for wC51F and loads the object palettes; wC5E0 1 becomes 2. The following entry clears the joypad state and runs the field mode states (E-0129)

02:737F.name: ComputeSRAMBank1RecordChecksum
02:737F.note: sums $29A * 10 bytes from sA06F in SRAM bank 1 and stores the complement plus $4321 at sBA73 (E-0129)

03:592E.name: ShowInventoryPageItemNames_Bank03
03:592E.note: shows the four item names of inventory page wMenuPage (or the empty-inventory text and wC61E entries) at vTiles2 + $5C0 onward, preserving the window (E-0129)

03:67B0.name: ShowRecordSkillPageNames_Bank03
03:67B0.note: shows four skill names of record wC46D & 3 for page wMenuPage (or string $0E when it has none) at vTiles2 + $5C0 onward, preserving the window (E-0129)

05:50E3.name: PassIfFoeAverageDEFAtMostTwiceAllyATK
05:50E3.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 2; otherwise $FF when the foes' average DEF is at most twice the allies' average ATK, else $00 (E-0129)

05:5275.name: PassIfFoeAverageATKAtMostTwiceAllyDEF
05:5275.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 2; otherwise $FF when the able foes' average ATK is at most twice the allies' average DEF, else $00 (E-0129)

05:5919.name: AIGateLoneAllyMPAndSkills
05:5919.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 3; with exactly one other occupied ally that has at most 20 MP, checks its skills ($A0, $1E/$1F) and status; returns $00 or $FF (E-0129)

05:667F.name: AIGateCompareAllyStatAverages
05:667F.note: C = 1 when the AI mode is below 4 or the actor knows a heal skill; otherwise compares the stat sums of the empty and occupied ally slots and returns $00 or $FF (E-0129)

0A:42BC.name: EnterStatusEffectFieldState
0A:42BC.note: in the field (story flag 2, not in mode states 1 or 7, outside listed maps): when a party member has status bit 2 or 0 of field $55, switches to mode state 7 and toggles wC88C (E-0129)

12:5C3F.name: SpawnScriptSpriteInFrontOfPlayer
12:5C3F.note: decompresses sprite graphics from bank $7E to vTiles0 + $700 (with a CGB palette), places it 16 pixels in front of the player and advances wScriptStep (E-0129)

12:689A.name: GenerateNewKeyEntry
12:689A.note: writes a generated key (kind $FE) into a free key slot, rerolling while it duplicates an existing key, and saves the random seed in wC787; hFFC6 = 1, or 0 when the list is full (E-0129)

14:60E6.name: ToggleVoicingMarkOnNameEntry
14:60E6.note: on the last glyph of the name entry wCFAD adds or cycles the marks $8D and $8E when the glyph allows them (lists Data_014_688A and 68CA), with sound $69 (E-0129)

15:6478.name: HandleThreeOptionMenuInput_15
15:6478.note: up/down moves wD786 over three options with sound $69; A chooses (option 2 cancels), sets wTwoChoiceCursor and requests script $80; B cancels (E-0129)

04:44CE.name: UpdateAndDrawSpriteSlots
04:44CE.note: unless bit 7 of wC468 is set: updates the sprite slots, then draws each slot's metasprite at its position relative to the scroll (E-0129)

16:56E4.name: CollectUniqueEncounterIdsToWD09F
16:56E4.note: for special maps copies the eight monster entries of the current screen (AddressOfKeyWorldMonstersEntryForCurrentScreen) to wD09F, removes duplicates and stores the count in wD09D; normal maps use Func_00A_4D5E (E-0129)

16:75EE.name: LoadSaveFileSummary
16:75EE.note: checks the save; when valid, loads the player name, play time, party summaries and other title-screen details from SRAM bank 1 into wD0D5 onward (E-0129)

16:78F9.name: DrawSaveSummaryPartyEntryC
16:78F9.note: for summary entry C (below B) loads its family icon, shows its 10-byte name and writes its level; otherwise blanks the entry (E-0129)

1C:6823.name: CopyRectToBGMapWrapped_1C
1C:6823.note: copies a B x C rectangle from DE to the BG map at HL, wrapping at the screen and map edges (E-0129)

1D:5F9C.name: MovePartyRecordsToFrontOfList
1D:5F9C.note: moves the party records found in the record list wD789 to its front and pads the list to $1E entries with $FF (E-0129)

1D:6088.name: DrawRecordListPageSpeciesNames
1D:6088.note: for the visible entries of page wD7AF draws the species name (field $0B, category 2 of the bank-08 database) of each listed record (E-0129)

1F:5D9A.name: FillTileRectWithArg1Tile
1F:5D9A.note: fills a wArg3 x wArg4 rectangle of the BG map at wArg5/6 (wrapping inside the 32-entry row) with the one tile byte at wArg1/2: unlike DrawTileRectFromArg1Params it never advances DE; on CGB, unless wArg7 is set, clears the same entries' attributes; every caller passes BGFillTile (E-0186, correcting E-0129)

1F:7601.name: ShowRecordBufBSkillNamesOrNone
1F:7601.note: shows the eight skill names of the record at wCA2B (field $34) in rows from vTiles2 + $200, or string $0E of category 8 when it has none (E-0129)

30:4AD3.name: ScoreActionsWithAIScoreTableA
30:4AD3.note: sets wDA6B/C to AIScoreRoutineTableA; for AI-controlled actors estimates damage, scores the eight skills, attack (0) and $AC into wD2AD, and doubles the weight of the preferred kind (E-0129)

32:514C.name: CheckFormationPartnersCanAct
32:514C.note: for the actor and its formation partner checks status blocks and MP costs of their stored actions (wDA2C) and returns flags in hFFC7 (E-0129)

36:5223.name: HealTargetHP
36:5223.note: restores the target's HP by the rolled skill amount, or fully for actions $20, $B1, $7B, $DA (with other cases for $18, $1A, $CF), capped at its max HP (E-0129)

37:5BC6.name: UnpackLinkRecordToWorkBuf
37:5BC6.note: unpacks the received partner record at wC986 into wD09D: names, species, family, parents, skills and scaled stats (E-0129)

37:5E3E.name: ScaleStatWordsToLinkFormat
37:5E3E.note: converts three stat words at DE: 999 becomes $01FF/$00FF, otherwise word * $33 or $19 / 100 rounded up; stores them at HL (E-0129)

3A:4A3A.name: SetEffectSpriteXForTargets
3A:4A3A.note: sets wD804 (and the wD805 list for all targets) to the screen X of the target from Data_03A_4AD5 by wDAB9 and the side count wD890 (E-0129)

3A:7508.name: BuildActionMessageNames
3A:7508.note: copies the actor, skill and target names to wC130/wC140/wC150 and picks the action message from Data_03A_7603 (or special messages $49-$4C) (E-0129)

3A:785A.name: WriteTargetNameOrTheMonsters
3A:785A.note: when the hFFC6 targets are all the same, copies the target name to wC130; otherwise writes "The monsters" (E-0129)

3A:7AE3.name: ListSideMonsterIdsToWC0A0
3A:7AE3.note: clears wC0A0 ($10 bytes) and lists the species ids of the occupied slots of the shown side at wC0A0 and of the other side at wC0A8 (E-0129)

3B:4990.name: RollTableDamageScaledByResistance
3B:4990.note: actions $24 onward: damage = random in the range from Data_03B_4A24[action - $24], then scaled by the target's resistance level for that element (85 percent at level 1, less above) (E-0129)

3B:4D1C.name: InflictStatus0Bit0WithBattleWordArray3FReduction
3B:4D1C.note: reduces the target's wD93F (or adds to wD89F for local targets); when status bits 0-1 are clear and the chance roll passes, sets status bit 0 (message $75) (E-0129)

60:4274.name: RollKeyWorldMonsterTableKeyWorldBossMonsters
60:4274.note: fills 8 two-byte entries from wCD50 with random monster ids from the band lists (Data_060_4123 row wCD02) (E-0129)

60:4607.name: RollKeyWorldEncounterTableLevels
60:4607.note: like RollKeyWorldEncounterTable, with each entry's level from wCD05 / 5 * 7 plus the area value, capped at 99 (E-0129)

60:4FEA.name: PlaceTwoRandomOpenCells
60:4FEA.note: picks two random open cells (ReadKeyWorldCellIsSolid) in the areas named by hFFC7 and hFFC8, avoiding the previous cell, and stores their positions (E-0129)

60:62F9.name: RefreshKeyWorldObjectsOnEntry
60:62F9.note: on key-world maps with bit 7 of wC893 set: sets the object count wCC47 from the band of the key level and drops objects for which Func_060_53E5 fails; marks the wC890 object (E-0129)

61:55AF.name: DrawKeyWorldObjectsEntryTilesForScreen
61:55AF.note: for the wCD7B entry on the current screen writes its 2 x 2 tile block ($46, or $70-$73) at wC240 with CGB attribute 5 (E-0129)

61:606D.name: KeyWorldAreaEncounterIndex
61:606D.note: hFFC6 = 1 when bit 7 of wCD07 is set; otherwise on map types $80/$85 the wCE7E entry of the current area (wCD74), else 0 (E-0129)

85:5DB9.name: AddHundredToPartyINTCapped999
85:5DB9.note: for each party record adds 100 to the INT word (field $69), capped at 999; far-called by Talk00FC_YouHaveToEat (E-0129)

F0:6AFE.name: RaiseRandomLowestResistance
F0:6AFE.note: while wCE9E > 0 and some resistance at wCF41 is below 3: picks at random one of the lowest-level resistances (levels 0, then 1, 2) and raises it (E-0129)

F1:4307.name: ShowInventoryPageItemNames_BankF1
F1:4307.note: shows the four item names of inventory page wMenuPage (or the empty-inventory text and wC61E entries) at vTiles2 + $5C0 onward, preserving the window (E-0129)

F2:4B05.name: DrawWCA83ExpAndToNextLevel
F2:4B05.note: writes the EXP wCA83-wCA85 as seven digits and, below the level cap, the EXP still needed for the next level (E-0129)

F2:4F47.name: DrawLevelAndStatusRowForWCA81
F2:4F47.note: writes the level wCA81 (marked $6F at the cap wCA82), its digits and the status marks from wCA80 into the BG map (E-0129)

F2:65E6.name: ClampPartyHPAndMPToMax
F2:65E6.note: for each party record sets HP (field $5B) and MP (field $5F) down to their maxima when they exceed them (E-0129)

00:13E5.name: LoadSGBBorderForSetA
00:13E5.note: when A differs from wC523: sends the Super Game Boy border tiles, map and palettes of set A through three compressed transfers (SGBTransferCompressed) (E-0130)

00:1906.name: LoadMapScreenFromChunk
00:1906.note: for the current map screen decompresses its tile block (chunk table in bank $61, indexed by hFFC6 and the screen position) into wScreenTileBuffer, and on CGB its attributes (E-0130)

00:1EA5.name: DrawScreenBufferToBGMapWithAttrs
00:1EA5.note: copies the 20 x 13 screen-buffer area (offset by bit 7 of wC8CB) to the BG map at HL, wrapping, and on CGB its attributes from WRAM bank 2 (E-0130)

02:64E5.name: OpenFieldMenuOnA
02:64E5.note: in the field, when A is pressed and nothing blocks it: saves the screen, sets the object flags and draws the field menu windows (Data_002_6606, 6642) (E-0130)

02:66CC.name: ShowIdlePartyStatusWindow
02:66CC.note: in the field, after $B4 idle frames: saves the bottom of the screen and shows the party status window (level, HP, MP) (E-0130)

02:6788.name: BuildPartyStatusWindowRows
02:6788.note: for each party member writes level (field $56), HP (field $5B) and MP (field $5F) into the status window at wC364 (offsets Data_002_6835) (E-0130)

02:69D0.name: StepTextWindowOpenClose
02:69D0.note: while wC8CB & 3 is set: copies the text window rows to or from wC300 (with CGB attributes) and redraws them at the scroll position (E-0130)

04:4025.name: SetupKeyWorldObjectsForMapType
04:4025.note: for key-world map types 2, 3, 4 and 6 places the area objects (stairs, chests, monsters) from the wCD89/wCDAC entries (E-0130)

05:585D.name: CompareFoeAverageATKWithAllyDEF
05:585D.note: compares twice the occupied foes' average ATK with the allies' average DEF; returns $00 or $FF in C (E-0130)

0A:561E.name: AdvanceStepCounterAndUpdateStoredRecords
0A:561E.note: counts steps in wC7C9 (wrapping at 1000); every 100 steps and at 1000 updates the stored SRAM records by their state byte and field $6E (E-0130)

0D:5D26.name: DrawKeyListPageMarks
0D:5D26.note: blanks the four mark positions and draws marks for the keys on the current page of wD789 (E-0130)

0D:5DED.name: DrawKeyListPageNames
0D:5DED.note: for the keys on the current page writes their names to wC8CF and draws them; generated keys (kind $FE) are shown as "Magic Key" (E-0130)

0E:59E1.name: AdjustStatForWCA2AAndWCACF
0E:59E1.note: when wCA2A or wCACF is set and listed for stat C (Data_00E_5A6B), subtracts Data_00E_5A8E[value] from DE (unless it is at 999) (E-0130)

0E:5EE8.name: ApplyBreedingBonusToChildStats
0E:5EE8.note: computes a bonus from personality compatibility, matching parent fields and wD7F1, and adds it to the child stats at wCAD0 (offsets Data_00E_5F89) (E-0130)

12:69B0.name: DeleteKeyEntryTemp0
12:69B0.note: removes key entry hFFC6: clears the matching wC88E link, marks its SRAM-bank-2 slot free and shifts the later entries down (E-0130)

12:722A.name: DrawTriggerMarkerSprite
12:722A.note: unless bit 7 of wC468 is set or no trigger is active (wC8FE = $FF), draws the trigger marker sprite (Data_012_7308) at the trigger cell wC8FF (E-0130)

12:7BCC.name: RunPendingFieldEventPendingFieldEvent
12:7BCC.note: on town maps runs the pending event in wC935 (bits 7 and 6 select the stage; some kinds need wC634); otherwise clears it (E-0130)

16:64DC.name: ListPartyAndStoredRecordsForPage
16:64DC.note: lists the party records and then the stored records (state 1, field $6E clear) in wD789 and sets the page counts wCFD0-wCFD3 (E-0130)

16:65FF.name: MovePagedListCursor
16:65FF.note: up/down/left/right move the cursor at [DE] and the page wCFD1 within the page sizes wCFD0/wCFD3 and page count wCFD2 (E-0130)

19:434D.name: LoadSlotSkillsFromBattlerRecord
19:434D.note: for slot C clears its skill list and copies the skills from its 78-byte battler record, then loads each skill record (with wD868 = 3) (E-0130)

19:49B1.name: AccumulateGrowthForLevelsTemp1
19:49B1.note: sums the stat word at record + $18 times each level 1..hFFC7 (with a /20 rounding term outside battle kind 3) into the 24-bit hFFCA-hFFCC (E-0130)

1B:7399.name: ListAvailableRecordsForSelection
1B:7399.note: lists in wD789 the stored records (state 1, or 2 unless wD7DC is 3) whose field $6E is clear and that are not already chosen in wD7DD; count in wD7A9 (E-0130)

33:5F99.name: ListAvailableRecordsForSelection_Bank33
33:5F99.note: lists in wD789 the stored records (state 1, or 2 unless wD7DC is 3) whose field $6E is clear and that are not already chosen in wD7DD; count in wD7A9 (E-0130)

1D:6320.name: DrawRecordListPageMarks
1D:6320.note: for the visible entries of page wD7AF draws each record's mark ($CC/$CD from field $0E, or $CE for state 2) beside it (E-0130)

1E:6FEB.name: DrawRecordFamilyEntries_6FEB
1E:6FEB.note: for record B draws the species names and marks named by the field lists $70D7 or $70DD (by bit 4 of field $0D), or a blank tile for missing entries (E-0130)

1E:725D.name: DrawRecordLevelAndStatusRow_1E
1E:725D.note: writes the record's level (field $56, marked $6F at the cap in field $57) and its status marks into the BG map at scroll + $29 (E-0130)

30:46BA.name: AddStatusAndHPWeightsToAI
30:46BA.note: adds AI weights for the actor's status (wD80D bits) and command mode, and for allies below a sixth of max HP in AI modes 3 and 4 (E-0130)

36:6346.name: RollChanceForLevelA_6346
36:6346.note: level A: 0 and 1 return, 2 and 3 take chance rolls; the following entries roll random values against $D8, $BF, $7F, $66, $4C, $3F and $26 (E-0130)

3A:4ADB.name: RunBattleEffectAnimation
3A:4ADB.note: runs the battle effect animation state wD800: loads the effect graphics, steps the effect sprite and its X positions, and ends the effect (E-0130)

60:408F.name: RollKeyWorldMonsterTableKeyWorldMonsters
60:408F.note: fills 32 two-byte entries from wCD10 with random monster ids from the wCCF7 band lists (rows from Data_060_4123 by wCD02) (E-0130)

60:53E5.name: PlaceKeyWorldObjectAtRandomCell
60:53E5.note: picks a random open cell within wCD0D x wCD0E not used by another object and stores it for object hFFC6 (E-0130)

60:54BB.name: RollKeyWorldObjectKind
60:54BB.note: picks an object kind for the key level band wCD0F from the chance rows at $556F and its contents ([DE + 1]) (E-0130)

60:639D.name: SetupTownObjectsForMap
60:639D.note: on town maps with bit 7 of wC893 set: sets the object count and band for the map, drops listed objects and marks the wC890 one (E-0130)

61:4001.name: ComputePartyStrengthLevelPartyStrength
61:4001.note: wCD05 = a strength value from the party's stats (AGL and INT halved, ATK, DEF, max HP), 0 without a party (E-0130)

61:474C.name: DrawKeyWorldExitTile
61:474C.note: draws the exit or stairs tile block for the current screen when it matches the area entry in wCE2D (E-0130)

61:54EC.name: DrawKeyWorldGoalAtScreen
61:54EC.note: on key-world maps draws the goal object for the current screen (from wC88F when the wC891 key matches, else from wCD0A) (E-0130)

61:562F.name: DrawWCD8BObjectTilesForScreen
61:562F.note: for the wCD8B object on the current screen draws its 4 x 2 or 2 x 2 tile blocks by kind (E-0130)

61:58BC.name: CheckKeyWorldWarpTable
61:58BC.note: checks the warp list Data_061_6566[wCDAC entry] against the current screen and warps when one matches; C = 0 when none (E-0130)

85:5B53.name: SetupMap0BMonsterObjects
85:5B53.note: on map $0B places four monster objects and picks the monster for the wC82C / wD7FF entry (table $5C5E) or a random one (E-0130)

F0:6BE0.name: RankFamilyScoresIntoFamilyRanking
F0:6BE0.note: ranks the 11 scores at wCEC3 in descending order (ties at random) into wCF7E, then wCF8A = BandOfFamilyBitCount (E-0130)

00:0150.note: entry after the header jump: wIsCGB = 1 when A was $11 at power-on; disables interrupts, sets the stack, clears RAM, installs the OAM DMA routine, clears VRAM, sets game mode 5 and the MBC banks, then runs the main loop (E-0131)

01:57E1.name: DebugToggleArg1Marker
01:57E1.note: debug: toggles wD7F1 between 0 and 2 and writes tile $10 + wD7F1 at vBGMap0 + $81; the following entries are the debug results screen input handlers (E-0131)

01:66AD.name: DebugBattleSetupLoadWords
