01:6903.name: DebugBattleSetupShowFieldString
01:6903.note: debug battle setup: shows the string for field wC46B (wD09D entries, ShowString_Bank88) at the window from Data_001_6A6C, with special cases for fields 4-6 (E-0131)

03:5AA7.name: DrawItemTargetStatPreview
03:5AA7.note: for item wItemId (kind Data_003_5C8B) writes the target record's affected value (HP, MP or a stat word) as digits in the item screen (E-0131)

0A:43EC.name: TickRandomEncounterCounter
0A:43EC.note: in the field when nothing blocks it: counts down the encounter or talk timers (wC901, wD091) and starts a battle or talk event when they expire (E-0131)

0E:5688.name: ComputeBreedingChild
0E:5688.note: clears the child record wCAD0 and fills it from the two parents (wC991, wCA36): species from the breeding table Data_00E_6208, then names, skills, resistances and stat bonuses (E-0131)

11:4130.name: CheckWarpsAtPlayerPosition
11:4130.note: special maps use CheckWarpsByMapType; otherwise checks the map exit table, then the warp list Data_011_67A6[hMapId] against the player position and warps on a match (E-0131)

14:7E96.name: DeleteSRAMRecordAndCompact
14:7E96.note: clears SRAM record wD7F1 (when below 30) and moves the later stored records up to fill the gap, updating the party list (E-0131)

15:6B00.name: ShowSaveFileInfoWindow
15:6B00.note: clears the text tiles and, when the save is valid, shows the save details (player name, play time, party) from SRAM in the window (E-0131)

16:7783.name: DrawTitleSaveSummaryScreen
16:7783.note: loads the summary graphics and palette, the save file summary, and draws the player name, party icons, names, levels and key name on the title screen (E-0131)

19:4BA8.name: LoadBattleSlotFromBattlerRecord_4BA8
19:4BA8.note: slot C: copies species, family, AI settings (wDA43/wDA4B outside link battles) and stats from its battler record into the battle arrays (E-0131)

19:4CF8.name: LoadBattleSlotFromBattlerRecord_4CF8
19:4CF8.note: slot C: copies species, family, wDA43 and stats from its battler record into the battle arrays and loads its skills (E-0131)

1A:5FA7.name: CheckSkillsLearnableAtLevel
1A:5FA7.note: copies the record's eight skills to wD09D and, for each skill in Data_01A_4FF8, checks the level and stat requirements; learnable skills go into the list (E-0131)

1A:60F1.name: FindNewlyLearnableSkills
1A:60F1.note: for record wD868 finds the skills of Data_01A_4FF8 not yet known whose level and stat requirements its stats now meet (E-0131)

1D:6E39.name: PackRecordFieldsToBank1Slot
1D:6E39.note: packs SRAM record wD7F1's family, state, mark and other fields into the compact form in SRAM bank wD7F2 (wD7E0 workspace) (E-0131)

1D:7492.name: UnpackRecordFromBank1Slot
1D:7492.note: unpacks the compact record in SRAM bank wD7F2 back into the record fields (family, state, mark ...) (E-0131)

1E:6D70.name: DrawRecordParentNames
1E:6D70.note: for record B draws the names of its parents (fields from $6ED2 or $6EDA by bit 4 of field $0D), or '???' when unknown (E-0131)

24:7045.name: StepItemDescriptionText
24:7045.note: draws the next glyph of the description of the item at wD7D5[4 * wD7B6 + wD7B5] (text table Data_024_7158), handling the $F0 and $F1 control bytes (E-0131)

31:5F9E.name: MoveBattleCommandCursor
31:5F9E.note: up/down/left/right move the battle command cursor entry wCFD5 within wCFD3, wCFD6, wCFD7, blinking it, with sound $69 (E-0131)

3B:4711.name: GroupTargetsBySpeciesToSpeciesGroups
3B:4711.note: lists the target side's species and groups the targets that share the target's species into wD88B-wD88D (bit 7 marks a group) (E-0131)

60:528B.name: PlaceObjectInAreaC
60:528B.note: finds area C in wCD70 and picks a random free cell inside it for the object (avoiding wCD7B and wCD8B entries) (E-0131)

61:40B4.name: ComputePartyStrengthForKey
61:40B4.note: computes the party strength from AGL + INT, ATK, DEF and max HP of each member into hFFCA-hFFCD and wCD05 for key generation (E-0131)

69:4001.name: LoadMapObjectsForScreen
69:4001.note: clears the sprite slots; key-world maps set up their objects, other maps load the object list for hMapId (with a story-flag case on map $2F) (E-0131)

A0:46CC.name: ComputeWildEncounterLevel
A0:46CC.note: computes the wild monster level wCFE3 and band wCFE4 from the party's stat totals (wD0F2-wD0FE) and size (E-0131)

32:51F9.name: CheckSkillMPCost
32:51F9.note: for a skill action (wBattleActionId outside $D0-$E3) the cost is byte 0 of the record in wRecordBufferData, copied to hFFC8. The actor's MP minus the cost is computed in HL; a negative result returns with D = 1 (not enough MP) and carry clear. Equal MP and cost succeeds (D = 0, carry set). The MP is not written here (E-0048)

32:59DF.name: ApplyDamageToTarget
32:59DF.note: target slot wBattleTarget (wD8A5): when wDAC1's top two bits are not 00 and not 01, wBattleHP[target] -= the 16-bit damage in wD872/wD873 and is clamped at 0 (a result below zero also decrements wCFCB and clears wCFCD); then sets bits 0, 1 and 2 of the target's wD095 flags

32:5B12.name: DefeatTarget
32:5B12.note: target slot wBattleTarget: re-derives its stats (Func_032_5C3F, Func_032_5B94, Func_032_5BE8 clear 'buff' bits), sets wBattleSlotOut[target] = 1, wBattleHP[target] = 0 and clears the target's 9-byte status record (wD80C + 9 * slot)

32:5C3F.name: RecomputeTargetMaxHPAndMP
32:5C3F.note: when bits 4-5 of the target's status byte (wD80D + 9 * slot) are set: stores GetBaseHP and GetBaseMP of the target in wBattleMaxHP and wBattleMaxMP and lowers the current values to the new maximum

36:4001.name: RunBattleResolveStep
36:4001.note: jumps through a 16-entry table indexed by wBattleResolveStep (wCFCB): one step of resolving a battle action; the steps advance wBattleResolveStep and use wBattleSubStep (wCFCC) and wBattleSubStep2 (wCFCD) for nested state

00:3F04.name: DivideHLByBC
00:3F04.note: HL = HL / BC (quotient), BC = HL mod BC; clobbers A, DE

00:3ED4.name: AdvanceRandom
00:3ED4.note: when wC58A is 0 calls NextTableByte (wC5E8 = index, wC5E7 = table byte); in link mode runs the same step on the synchronised copy in wC5BA/wC5BB

00:3E98.name: RandomInRange
00:3E98.note: HL = minimum, BC = maximum: returns DE = minimum + (random mod (maximum - minimum + 1)), the random value being wC5E8:wC5E7 after AdvanceRandom; DE = HL when the two are equal (73 call sites)

36:5025.name: ComputeBasicDamage
36:5025.note: the damage formula: HL = the acting slot's value from the array at wD8FF (Func_036_7E2E), BC = the value to compare with, set by the caller. If HL <= BC the damage is RandomInRange(0, 1). Otherwise, with half = (HL - BC) / 2: when HL / 16 >= half the damage is RandomInRange(0, HL / 16); else it is half + RandomInRange(-(half / 16), half / 16) + RandomInRange(-1, 1). The 16-bit result goes to wBattleDamageLo/Hi. The divisors are 16, not 4: ShiftHLRight4 falls through two more shifts (corrected in E-0064)

36:7E2E.name: GetBattleATK
36:7E2E.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wD8FF (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E33.name: GetBattleDEF
36:7E33.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wD90F (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E38.name: GetBattleMaxHP
36:7E38.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wBattleMaxHP (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E3D.name: GetBattleMaxMP
36:7E3D.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wBattleMaxMP (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E42.name: GetBattleHP
36:7E42.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wBattleHP (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E47.name: GetBattleMP
36:7E47.note: A = battle slot: HL = the word for that slot in the array at wBattleMP (Func_036_7E5B)

36:7E5B.name: ReadBattleWordFromArray
36:7E5B.note: HL = array base, A = slot: HL = the 16-bit word at HL + 2 * A

31:40D6.name: BattlePhase0
31:40D6.note: wBattlePhase = 0: the start of the battle (E-0044)

31:43B2.name: BattlePhaseFight
31:43B2.note: wBattlePhase = 1: the fight; steps: 1 set-up, 2 command entry, 3 executing the actions (E-0044)

31:43E6.name: BattlePhaseEnd
31:43E6.note: wBattlePhase = 2: after the fight; steps 0-9 (result message, rewards, recruiting) (E-0044)

31:4B10.name: RunBattleSetup
31:4B10.note: battle fight step 1: one sub-step per wBattleSubPhase (13 cases, 0-12 observed in the first battle) that builds the battle screen and loads the combatants

30:4001.name: RunBattleCommandEntry
30:4001.note: battle fight step 2: returns while a message is being drawn (wC52B); otherwise one of 7 sub-steps by wBattleSubPhase; case 0 loads the slots' personality bytes (wSlotPersonality*), the command menu loop follows

3A:6157.name: RunBattleActions
3A:6157.note: battle fight step 3: returns while a message is being drawn; in link mode calls Func_03A_4ADB; otherwise one of 6 sub-steps by wBattleSubPhase, which execute the chosen actions through RunBattleResolveStep

3A:68C9.name: RunBattleStep4
3A:68C9.note: battle fight step 4: the same prologue as RunBattleActions, then its own sub-steps (not seen in the first battle)

36:4806.name: ResolveStepDamageMessage
36:4806.note: resolve step $0A: advances wBattleResolveStep and, for the actor or target side chosen by wDAC0 bit 4, stores wDAC2 or wDAC3 in wC0A0 and calls Func_036_4991 / Func_036_4A38; the first fight showed the battle text 'took N damage!' (bank $2F, category 1, index 53) at this step

36:4901.name: ResolveStepDefeat
36:4901.note: resolve step $0D: runs the defeat sequence Func_032_5A3A (RunDefeatSequence); the first fight showed 'was defeated!' (category 1, index 139) at this step

32:5A3A.name: RunDefeatSequence
32:5A3A.note: three sub-steps by wBattleSubStep2: 0 lowers a counter (wDA5B + target by 5) and calls DefeatTarget, 1 runs Func_032_5AB3, 2 advances wBattleResolveStep, sets bit 2 of the target's wD095 flags and starts the defeat message (Func_03A_7193)

03:4692.name: PauseMenu_Main
03:4692.note: GameMode2_Update, wModeState 0: the main pause menu: PLAN (Keys, Plan, Text Speed, Re-Order, Info, Journal) and, for the first monster, INFO with its level, ATK, DEF, AGL, INT, WLD, HP and MP (E-0046)

03:5274.name: PauseMenu_Items
03:5274.note: GameMode2_Update, wModeState 1: the ITEM list ('No items' at the start of a game) (E-0046)

03:5E89.name: PauseMenu_Skills
03:5E89.note: GameMode2_Update, wModeState 2: the SKILLS list ('No skills' at the start) (E-0046)

03:6A9D.name: PauseMenu_State3
03:6A9D.note: GameMode2_Update, wModeState 3: an item list screen (state 3) (E-0046)

03:402F.name: PauseMenu_State4
03:402F.note: GameMode2_Update, wModeState 4: hands over to Func_0F1_4001 (state 4) (E-0046)

74:4001.name: MonsterPic_DrakSlime
74:4001.note: compressed 6 x 6 picture (36 tiles) of monster id $001 (DrakSlime); 67 other ids point here too (MonsterPictureTable / MonsterAttributeMapTable)

74:40F1.name: MonsterPic_SpotSlime
74:40F1.note: compressed 6 x 6 picture (36 tiles) of monster id $002 (SpotSlime); 1 other ids point here too (MonsterPictureTable / MonsterAttributeMapTable)

74:4182.name: MonsterPic_WingSlime
74:4182.note: compressed 6 x 6 picture (36 tiles) of monster id $003 (WingSlime) (MonsterPictureTable / MonsterAttributeMapTable)

74:42A4.name: MonsterPic_TreeSlime
74:42A4.note: compressed 6 x 6 picture (36 tiles) of monster id $004 (TreeSlime) (MonsterPictureTable / MonsterAttributeMapTable)

74:4347.name: MonsterPic_Snaily
74:4347.note: compressed 6 x 6 picture (36 tiles) of monster id $005 (Snaily) (MonsterPictureTable / MonsterAttributeMapTable)

74:43FE.name: MonsterPic_SlimeNite
74:43FE.note: compressed 6 x 6 picture (36 tiles) of monster id $006 (SlimeNite) (MonsterPictureTable / MonsterAttributeMapTable)

74:44F9.name: MonsterPic_Babble

A3:41CF.name: FindFormationForSide
A3:41CF.note: walks FormationTable for the actor's side (wBattleActor & 4): the first record whose three actions match the side's chosen actions (DE) with every required slot able to act gives A = 1 and hFFC6 = its combined action, after FormationCompatibilityRoll when its flag is 1 or in link mode 2; A = 0 when none applies (E-0172)

A3:44C4.name: FormationCompatibilityRoll
A3:44C4.note: picks the slot pair by B / 3, reads PersonalityCompatibility[personality of the second][personality of the first] + 1, multiplies it by the pair's wSlotTrait sum and by FormationChanceFactors[action - $D0], divides by 10 (capped at 255) and returns A = 1 when a random 0-99 is below that (E-0172)

05:5A38.name: FailIfAbleAllyKnowsSkillList6D1A
05:5A38.note: C = 1 when the actor's AI mode is below 3; otherwise C = $00 when another slot of the actor's side can act, has status byte 1 bit 6 clear and knows a skill CountSkillsInList6D1A counts, else $FF (E-0175)

05:5A73.name: FailIfAllyLacksMPForSkillList5AF8
05:5A73.note: C = 1 when the actor's AI mode is below 3; otherwise C = $00 when another able slot of the actor's side knows skill $4D, $3D, $3E, $3F, $66, $67 ... and has less MP than its cost in Data_005_5AF8, else $FF (the pattern of FailIfAllyLacksMPForHealSkill) (E-0175)

05:6D1A.name: CountSkillsInList6D1A
05:6D1A.note: A = how many of slot A's eight skills are $03, $06, $09, $0C, $0F, $12, $13 or $14 (Z set when none); BC kept (E-0175)

04:4E0F.name: IsFadingAtMap5AScreen00Y80

04:4BE4.name: DrawPlayerOverlaySprite21Or22
04:4BE4.note: moves the sprite origin down 8, sets tile offset $70 and palette 7, then draws meta-sprite set $21 (hPlayerStateFlags bit 3 set) or $22 with DrawMetaSprite (E-0175)

04:4C25.name: DrawFollowerSpriteIfFlag1B
04:4C25.note: unless hFieldDrawFlags bit 1 is set, and only when story flag $1B is set: draws the follower sprite from wFollowerRecords bytes 1-2 (set from hPlayerSpriteVariant, with a different frame when IsFadingAtMap5AScreen00Y80) (E-0175)

04:4D43.name: DrawPartyFollowerSprites
04:4D43.note: for each party member (wPartyCount) walks wFollowerRecords and wPartyList and draws its follower sprite unless the matching hFieldDrawFlags bit is set (E-0175)

14:6CEA.name: CopyF0StringAndRedrawNameEntry
14:6CEA.note: copies the $F0-terminated string at HL to DE, then erases the name-entry cursor tile and redraws wNameEntryText glyph by glyph (handling the $9F cursor end and the $8D/$8E voicing marks) (E-0175)

00:2F84.name: WriteBCAsDecimalString
00:2F84.note: writes BC (below 10,000) as decimal digit bytes at HL without leading zeros, each followed by a $F0 terminator that the next digit overwrites (DivideBCByDE by 1000, 100, 10, then the remainder) (E-0180)

30:499E.name: AIPickRandomActionOfKind1
30:499E.note: lists action 0 plus every skill of the actor whose kind byte (the byte before it in wBattleSkills, wBattleSkillsPrefix + 16 * slot) is 1, picks one at random as the actor's action choice and sets wLoadSlot = $FF (choice weight 1 of AIChoiceRoutineTable) (E-0181)

30:49FD.name: AIPickRandomSkillOfKind2
30:49FD.note: lists the actor's skills of kind 2 (as AIPickRandomActionOfKind1, without action 0) and picks one at random as the action choice; returns when there is none (choice weight 2) (E-0181)

30:4A58.name: AIPickRandomSkillOfKind3
30:4A58.note: lists the actor's skills of kind 3, adds skill $AC when Func_030_540C returns 2, and picks one at random as the action choice; returns when there is none (choice weight 3) (E-0181)
